smt-2012-calculus-02.prompt: Find the maximum value of $$\int_{-\pi/2}^{3\pi/2}\sin(x)f(x)\,dx$$ subject to the constraint $|f(x)|\le5$.

smt-2012-calculus-04.prompt: Compute the $x$-coordinate of the point on the curve $y=\sqrt x$ that is closest to the point $(2,1)$.

smt-2012-calculus-07.prompt: A differentiable function $g$ satisfies $$\int_0^x(x-t+1)g(t)\,dt=x^4+x^2$$ for all $x\ge0$. Find $g(x)$.

smt-2012-calculus-09.prompt: Find the ordered pair $(\alpha,\beta)$ with non-infinite $\beta\ne0$ such that $$\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{\sqrt[n^2]{1!\,2!\cdots n!}}{n^{\alpha}}=\beta$$ holds.

smt-2012-calculus-10.prompt: Find the maximum of $$\int_0^1f(x)^3\,dx$$ given the constraints $$-1\le f(x)\le1,\qquad\int_0^1f(x)\,dx=0.$$
